saw_lines: Activewear buyers pick by fit and feel, then come back for the same leggings or bra in a second colour.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where shoppers judge the fit before a click.
Your site offers 15% off three items, yet only 2 of 22 ads mention percent off. Lead three new ads with the buy three offer, printed on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 15% off three items, but 2 of 22 ads mention it. Without that deal, a first-time buyer has no reason to add a second item. Put the buy three offer in line one of three new ads.

None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so a first-time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before the click. Collect one number, like orders shipped, and open three ads with it on the creative.

Three of your 22 ads are creator posts with a code, #ad or @mention, yet they run from the brand page. Whitelist those three posts from each creator account so the creator name carries the ad, then cut three variations.
20 of your ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 10 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest winner, keeping its hook and swapping the product.

ads_1: Creator-led video tests that open on the buy three, save 15% offer
